name: mysmb-marketplace
description: Curated agent plugins for SMB-focused business integrations - Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe, HubSpot, and more.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Read GitHub issues and Projects via GitHub's hosted MCP server. One-click OAuth when the workspace has the built-in app enabled; bring-your-own OAuth app otherwise.

plugins.name: deskcrm
plugins.description: Lightweight SMB CRM backed by an Excel workbook. Stores contacts and accounts in Contacts and Accounts sheets and exposes CRUD operations over a stdio MCP server. Primarily used for testing the marketplace and plugin lifecycle.

plugins.name: microsoft-365
plugins.description: Access Microsoft 365 emails, calendar, files, Teams, and people via Microsoft Graph. Six MCP servers with independent OAuth scopes — mail is split into read (user-consentable) and send (admin-consent).

plugins.name: dataverse
plugins.description: Microsoft Dataverse / Dynamics 365 Sales & Customer Service via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. 50+ tools across accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, cases, queues, knowledge articles, entitlements, and SLAs — CRUD, Sales actions, CS actions (resolve/reopen cases, queue management), FetchXML, and metadata. Multi-environment auto-discovered at sign-in.

plugins.name: master-agent
plugins.description: Connect to and orchestrate the Microsoft Copilot Studio agents in your tenant via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Discover every agent the signed-in user can reach, delegate a question to the right specialist, hold multi-turn conversations, and synthesize the answer — one front door for all your Copilot agents.

plugins.name: myconnect-builder
plugins.description: Assign myConnect change requests as WorkQ items and let the myConnect Builder plan, build, and deploy them. Includes the Change Request WorkQ template and a workspace skill explaining the pipeline; a laptop-side bridge (in the plugin's bridge/ directory) drives Claude Code against the myConnect repo and reports back on the item, with PM approval gates for plan and release.

plugins.name: quickbooks-accounting
plugins.description: Full QuickBooks Online Accounting v3 coverage via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. ~190 tools — CRUD on all 38 Accounting entities, void/send/PDF on transactions, all 30 standard reports, raw query, batch, and change-data-capture. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: myob-accounting
plugins.description: MYOB AccountRight & Business via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. 28 tools covering sales invoices, purchase bills, contacts, chart of accounts, tax codes, payments, and financial reports. AU/NZ organisations only. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: netsuite
plugins.description: Oracle NetSuite ERP via the myHub-hosted TBA (Token-Based Authentication) MCP gateway. Tools across accounts, contacts, customers, transactions, and SuiteQL querying — plus dashboard analytics for revenue summaries, AR aging, open sales orders, cash position, and top customers. Requires five TBA credentials: account ID, consumer key/secret, token ID/secret.

plugins.name: xero-accounting
plugins.description: Full Xero Accounting API coverage via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. 119 tools covering sales, purchases, banking, attachments, history, linked transactions, expense claims, receipts, payment services, and all 8 financial reports. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: xero-projects
plugins.description: Xero Projects via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Projects, tasks, time entries, project users. 12 tools. Includes a client-portal widget showing staffed-employee time entries Sun–Sat with week navigation.

plugins.name: xero-practice-manager
plugins.description: Xero Practice Manager (XPM) via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Manage clients, jobs, tasks, time entries, staff, and invoices for your accounting practice.

plugins.name: xero-assets
plugins.description: Xero Fixed Assets register via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. List, view, and register fixed assets. 5 tools.

plugins.name: xero-finance
plugins.description: Read-only Xero Finance API — cash validation, AR/AP statements, account usage, bank statement reconciliation. Higher-fidelity than Accounting reports. 6 tools.

plugins.name: xero-payroll-au
plugins.description: Xero Payroll AU — employees, pay runs, leave, timesheets, superannuation. AU organisations only. 24 tools.

plugins.name: linkedin
plugins.description: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions via the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. Campaign analytics — spend, impressions, clicks, and CTR across your LinkedIn ad campaigns.

plugins.name: monday
plugins.description: Access monday.com boards, items, groups, columns, updates, users, and WorkForms via monday's hosted OAuth MCP server (mcp.monday.com). Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: zoho-crm
plugins.description: Zoho CRM v8 via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Records (CRUD on any module), COQL, search, notes, attachments, tags, related lists, mass actions, lead conversion, settings, users, send mail. Per-user datacenter routing.

plugins.name: zoho-people
plugins.description: Zoho People HRIS via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Employees, departments, leave, attendance, timesheets, files, approvals, plus a generic forms CRUD escape hatch.

plugins.name: zoho-recruit
plugins.description: Zoho Recruit v2 (ATS) via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Candidates, job openings, clients, contacts, interviews, plus candidate↔job association, status changes, and resume upload/parse.

plugins.name: zoho-sign
plugins.description: Zoho Sign v1 e-signature workflows via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Send documents for signature, manage templates, track requests, recall/remind, download signed PDFs.

plugins.name: salesforce
plugins.description: Access Salesforce CRM data via the Salesforce-hosted MCP gateway. Opportunities, accounts, contacts, and SOQL queries for sales pipeline visibility.

plugins.name: cliniko-scheduling
plugins.description: Manage Cliniko appointments, availability, and bookings via the myHub-hosted Cliniko MCP gateway. Individual and group appointments, appointment types, availability, online bookings, cancellations and DNAs.

plugins.name: cliniko-patients
plugins.description: Manage Cliniko patients, contacts, and referral sources via the myHub-hosted Cliniko MCP gateway. Patient records, patient cases, non-patient contacts, and referral attribution.

plugins.name: cliniko-clinical
plugins.description: Access Cliniko clinical records via the myHub-hosted Cliniko MCP gateway. Treatment notes, medical alerts, and patient attachments — gated by your own Cliniko permissions.

plugins.name: cliniko-billing
plugins.description: Manage Cliniko invoices, payments, and products via the myHub-hosted Cliniko MCP gateway. Invoicing, payment recording and allocation, products, and billable items.

plugins.name: cliniko-practice
plugins.description: Manage Cliniko practitioners, businesses, users, and account settings via the myHub-hosted Cliniko MCP gateway. The structural practice-administration data behind the rest of Cliniko.

plugins.name: surepact-grants
plugins.description: Search Australian government and community grants via SurePact's Intelligent Grants API — filter by state and get titles, descriptions, funding amounts, and open/close dates.

plugins.name: talkdesk
plugins.description: Talkdesk AI Agent Platform integration via the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. Exposes mySMB Workspace knowledge search and call QA scoring as MCP tools. API-key auth, no OAuth required.

plugins.name: talkdesk-demo
plugins.description: Talkdesk integration demo with static sample data — no Talkdesk account required. Installs the Call QA Scorecard, Knowledge Search, and Call History widgets into the Workspace. Swap for the 'talkdesk' plugin once a real account is provisioned.

plugins.name: sprout-employee
plugins.description: Manage Sprout employee 201 records via the myHub-hosted Sprout MCP gateway. List/create/update employees and their work, payroll, contact, government and schedule sections; search; prevalidate; and resolve employee lookups. Machine-to-machine OAuth — paste your Sprout client id/secret, no bearer token.

plugins.name: sprout-hr-general
plugins.description: Read Sprout HR General reference data and admin configuration via the myHub-hosted Sprout MCP gateway: companies, departments, locations, clients, employee/benefit/visa/asset lookups, company policies, access levels (roles), and notification settings.

plugins.name: sprout-time-attendance
plugins.description: Manage Sprout time & attendance via the myHub-hosted Sprout MCP gateway: attendance (DTR) logs, leave/overtime/undertime/official-business requests, approvals, leave credits, and schedules. Submit requests with create_requests; push biometric logs in batches.

plugins.name: sprout-payroll
plugins.description: Work with Sprout payroll via the myHub-hosted Sprout MCP gateway: one-time external adjustments (earnings/deductions), overtime rates, payroll runs, approved payroll per employee, and report downloads (payroll summary, payslip PDF, BIR Form 2316).

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Integrates Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Chat, and Contacts via Google Workspace MCP servers. OAuth 2.0 Bearer token auth — one token covers all five services.

plugins.name: employment-hero
plugins.description: Access Employment Hero HR & payroll data via the myHub-hosted OAuth MCP gateway. Employees, leave requests, timesheets, teams, and pay details.

plugins.name: worx-safety
plugins.description: Australian workplace health and safety (WHS) compliance via Worx Safety. Manage inductees, documents, issues, assets, projects, and registers — all WHS obligations in one place. Static API token auth.

plugins.name: shopify-storefront
plugins.description: Connect to Shopify's public Storefront and UCP catalog MCP servers. Browse products, manage carts, and look up store policies — no authentication required.

plugins.name: shopify-customer
plugins.description: Connect to Shopify's Customer Accounts MCP server. Access authenticated customer data — order history, order details, saved addresses, and account profile — via OAuth 2.0 + PKCE.

plugins.name: ignition
plugins.description: Ignition proposal and client management via Ignition's hosted OAuth MCP server. 78 tools across 16 groups — agreed services, billing items, clients & contacts, deals, discovery, email templates, forms, invoices, message templates, payments, practice, proposals, services, tax rates, terms templates, and users. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.description: Connect to your Slack workspace — search messages, read/send in channels, manage canvases, and look up users via Slack's official MCP server.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Access Notion pages, databases, tasks, and workspace members via Notion's official hosted OAuth MCP server (mcp.notion.com). Create documentation, search content, manage tasks, build reports, and plan campaigns. Browser OAuth — no API keys.

plugins.name: mailchimp-transactional
plugins.description: Send and manage transactional emails via Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill). Check account status, build templates, call any Transactional API endpoint, and diagnose failed sends — all through Mailchimp's official hosted MCP server. API-key auth.

plugins.name: sinch
plugins.description: Sinch Engage SMS platform via the @sinch-engage/mcp-server stdio MCP server. Send SMS messages, generate detailed and summary delivery reports, and manage contacts and contact groups. API key + secret auth, AU and EU regions supported.

plugins.name: docusign
plugins.description: DocuSign agreement workflows via DocuSign's hosted MCP server. eSignature envelopes, User Management, Workflow Builder orchestration, and Agreement Manager — 21 tools across four API groups. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: calendly
plugins.description: Manage Calendly scheduling via the official Calendly-hosted MCP server (mcp.calendly.com). List and manage event types, view upcoming meetings, check availability, schedule with invitees, and administer your organisation. Browser OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with Dynamic Client Registration — no API keys required.

plugins.name: basiq
plugins.description: Connect to Basiq's open banking platform to access financial data, bank connections, transactions, and account information via AI. Surfaces Basiq's full API through seven built-in MCP tools covering endpoint discovery, documentation search, and live API execution.

plugins.name: servicem8
plugins.description: ServiceM8 field-service management via ServiceM8's hosted OAuth MCP server (https://go.servicem8.com/mcp). Search and list jobs and clients, create jobs from templates, add job notes, and list staff members and job templates. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

plugins.name: hubspot
plugins.description: Access HubSpot CRM via a mySMB-owned OAuth app — contacts, companies, deals, tickets, custom objects (e.g. a Members object for association-management use cases), and the Associations API for linking records across object types.

plugins.name: square
plugins.description: Square commerce platform via Square's hosted OAuth MCP server. Access 280+ Square API operations across payments, customers, orders, invoices, subscriptions, catalog, inventory, loyalty, bookings, and more — via three MCP tools. Browser OAuth — sign in with your Square account, no API keys required.

plugins.name: stripe
plugins.description: Read-only Stripe data via the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. Payments, customers, subscriptions, invoices, balance, payouts, products, and prices. No API keys required — server-side auth.

plugins.name: simpro
plugins.description: Simpro job management — quotes, jobs, customers and invoices for field-service and trade contractors. Quotes originate from Ground Plan estimating software.

plugins.name: charitabl
plugins.description: Discover Australian charities and donate — search visible charities, browse featured causes, and get donation links. No account needed.

plugins.name: charitabl-curator
plugins.description: Charity curator tools for Charitabl — donation dashboard, donation reports, charity profile changes, and donation widget management for your charity.

plugins.name: charitabl-giving
plugins.description: Your personal giving on Charitabl — donation history, tax-deductible totals, and recurring gifts.

plugins.name: consolidated-calendar
plugins.description: One calendar view across Outlook (Microsoft 365), Google Calendar, and iCloud. Ships a consolidated dashboard tile that merges today's events from all three sources chronologically with source badges, plus a cross-calendar agenda skill. OAuth for Microsoft and Google; app-specific password for iCloud.
